entries.title: Leviticus 24:1
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Leviticus 24:2
segments: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clean olive oil for the light, so that a light may be burning at all times,

entries.title: Leviticus 24:3
segments: Outside the veil of the ark in the Tent of meeting; let Aaron see that it is burning from evening till morning at all times before the Lord: it is a rule for ever through all your generations.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:4
segments: Let Aaron put the lights in order on the support before the Lord at all times.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:5
segments: And take the best meal and make twelve cakes of it, a fifth part of an ephah in every cake.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:6
segments: And put them in two lines, six in a line, on the holy table before the Lord.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:7
segments: And on the lines of cakes put clean sweet-smelling spices, for a sign on the bread, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:8
segments: Every Sabbath day regularly, the priest is to put it in order before the Lord: it is offered for the children of Israel, an agreement made for ever.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:9
segments: And it will be for Aaron and his sons; they are to take it for food in a holy place: it is the most holy of all the offerings made by fire to the Lord, a rule for ever.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:10
segments: ¶And a son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel and had a fight with a man of Israel by the tents;

entries.title: Leviticus 24:11
segments: And the son of the Israelite woman said evil against the holy Name, with curses; and they took him to Moses. His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:12
segments: And they kept him shut up, till a decision might be given by the mouth of the Lord.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:13
segments: And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Leviticus 24:14
segments: Take the curser outside the tent-circle; and let all in whose hearing the words were said put their hands on his head, and let him be stoned by all the people.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:15
segments: And say to the children of Israel, As for any man cursing God, his sin will be on his head.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:16
segments: And he who says evil against the name of the Lord will certainly be put to death; he will be stoned by all the people; the man who is not of your nation and one who is an Israelite by birth, whoever says evil against the holy Name is to be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:17
segments: And anyone who takes another's life is certainly to be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:18
segments: And anyone wounding a beast and causing its death, will have to make payment for it: a life for a life.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:19
segments: And if a man does damage to his neighbour, as he has done, so let it be done to him;

entries.title: Leviticus 24:20
segments: Wound for wound, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever damage he has done, so let it be done to him.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:21
segments: He who puts a beast to death will have to make payment for it; he who puts a man to death will himself be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:22
segments: You are to have the same law for a man of another nation living among you as for an Israelite; for I am the Lord your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 24:23
segments: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, and they took the man who had been cursing outside the tent-circle and had him stoned. The children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
